name: ARIEL_Gaia_Benchmark
description: A HuggingFace-hosted benchmark built around ARIEL/Gaia-derived items that evaluates model performance on tasks related to astronomical/catalog knowledge and factual QA. It appears to focus on retrieval-style factual questions and short-answer items about objects and measurements drawn from mission catalogs.
reputation: A small, niche dataset hosted on HuggingFace with limited community traction compared to major QA benchmarks.
